versions.description: Loops PROD idle v2; cuts into idleV2+HeadTurn or idleV2+WeightShift — copies of the idle with a motion on top, so the cut lands on idle frames.
LOCAL models (Wan 2.2 5B). Calm 'lone sentinel' wording, loop closed in the sheet.
LOCAL. Looks around; cut where it is closest to rest, then blended into the exact start frame.
LOCAL. Loosens and re-grips the bow; blended back into the exact start frame.

LOCAL keyframes: 4 Qwen-edited keys + Wan 2.2 14B in-betweens, breathing.
Head swap for the over-shoulder key. M1 Max: 2h08 build + ~1.5h keys.

LOCAL v3: whole-body key (no graft), pose guard, breathing in-betweens, mouth patched shut.
Wan 2.2 14B 2x33 frames, return = out-bound reversed. Grey plate, no upscale. M1 Max ~1h.

LOCAL v4: one turn out, two breaths held at the glance, one turn back. Whole-body key, pose guard.
Wan 2.2 14B 2 segments + reverses, mouth patched shut, grey plate, no upscale. M1 Max ~1.5h.

PROD IDLE (2026-10-04). Breathing only: one slow breath K0 -> K0, Wan 2.2 14B 65 frames, face locked to K0,
loop seam crossfaded, grey plate, flood matte, no upscale, 16 fps. The base every extra motion is layered on.

idleV2 + HeadTurn: head rendered as a 480x384 close-up (4x the face pixels) from idle frame 16 to the glance key,
FILM 4x + constant-speed retime, pasted onto a copy of PROD idle v2 (frames 16-112). Starts and ends on idle frames. 16 fps.

idleV2 + WeightShift (key D): rendered FROM idle frame 16 (exact joins, no crossfade), frames 17-79. Retimed on the hips'
real travel (eased, wobble skipped, FILM-bridged), face locked, enclosed-plate cleanup. Starts and ends on idle frames. 16 fps.
